entities.summary: Augusto César Lima Brito is a Brazilian-Spanish professional basketball player for Fuenlabrada of the Primera FEB. He is 6 ft 10 in (2.08 m) tall and he can play as either a power forward or a center. He is left handed, but at the age of ten, his parents forced him to learn to write and shoot with the right. He was born in Rio de Janeiro.
